roles.description: Role name to its permissions and the roles it inherits. `*` is every permission; `posts.*` every permission starting with `posts.`.

default_role.description: Global role given to every new user; null gives none.

admins.description: Emails that get the admin_role globally, on signup or at start if the account exists. Bootstraps the first admin.

manage_permission.description: Permission needed to change roles and grants. Held in a tenant, it lets the holder manage that tenant only.
